run_advi_inference: run ADVI variational inference on a random variable with queries and observations
run_map_inference: run MAP variational inference to find the maximum a posteriori estimate of a random variable
run_variational_infer_with_guide: run VariationalInfer with a custom guide distribution mapping queries to variational guides
test_neals_funnel_distribution: test Neal's funnel distribution sampling and log probability computation with variational inference
test_bayesian_robust_linear_regression: test Bayesian robust linear regression inference using ADVI or MAP with Student-T priors
